scheme_name: Gharelu Hinsa Ki Pidita Ke Liye Sahayta Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh.
Applicant must be a woman or girl.
Applicant must be affected by domestic violence.
Application must be submitted within one year from the date of the incident.
A copy of the FIR lodged for the incident must be attached with the application.
benefits_summary: Compensation up to ₹2,00,000 for disability below 40% and up to ₹4,00,000 for disability above 40% resulting from domestic violence.
documents_required: Copy of the FIR lodged for the incident
